ask: Oh thank goodness, a person. I'm giving a speech in ten minutes and my notes are in a box back there. I can't stop, if I stop I'll lose my nerve. Could you grab it? The box says NOTES.
where: Across the path from where you came in, not far. A box that says NOTES.
thanks: NOTES! Page one is upside down but that's how I wrote it. You are a wonderful stranger. Right. Speech. Speech speech speech.
too_late: They've started without me. I'll wing it. I've winged worse. Probably. Thank you for trying, really, I mean it.

ask: You again! Good, you're fast. The speech went fine, mostly, but my sister's present is still out there in a box and the party is after the speech, which is now. It's a big box that says GIFT. Way out past the end of my path. Please.
ask_after_miss: You're still here! Oh thank goodness, thank you for still being here. The speech was, let's call it improvised, and that's on me, I left the box too far out. Right. Breathe. One more, a bigger one: my sister's present, in a box that says GIFT, way past the end of my path, and the party is now, it's now. Would you? Only if you want to. Please want to.
where: Past one end of the path and keep going. A box that says GIFT.
thanks: The GIFT. She's going to cry. I'm going to cry. You might cry, you've earned it. Go on, I've got a party to be late to.
too_late: No no no, they're cutting the cake. Fine. FINE. I'll tell her it's in the post. Thank you anyway. You were brilliant and I was a mess.

ask: Last thing, last thing, I promise. My shoes. I'm in socks. There are two boxes out there, LEFT SHOE and RIGHT SHOE, I don't know why I packed them separately, that's a question for later me. One at a time. I'll wait. Go!
ask_after_miss: Don't be sorry, the GIFT was mine to lose, I hid it halfway to the sea. You came back, that's the part I'll remember. Last thing, truly the last: I'm in socks. Two boxes, LEFT SHOE and RIGHT SHOE, I packed them apart, don't ask. One at a time, quick as you can, I'm wobbling. Go, go, go!
where: Off to one side of the path, not far. A box that says LEFT SHOE.

then.ask: Yes! One shoe. Now I'm hopping. The other box says RIGHT SHOE and it's the other way, of course it is. Quick, people are looking.
then.where: The other way from the first one, across the path. A box that says RIGHT SHOE.

thanks: Both shoes! On the wrong feet. There's no time, it's fine. Thank you, thank you, thank you. If anyone asks, I was never late for anything.
too_late: I'll go in socks. Socks are a statement. Thank you, honestly, you did more than anyone. Right. Socks.
